scope: Clipboard QR replay / screenshot OCR detection / localStorage tamper / double-tap redeem / browser back mid-wizard / race condition

adversarial_findings.title: A1 clipboard QR replay attack defended (no user-select copy path)
adversarial_findings.evidence: QR payload stored as data-payload attribute (not selectable text). Member number displayed = 'FK-{member_number}' format, distinct from QR payload 'FK:{loyalty_code}'. Attacker cannot OCR/copy payload via long-press because element is <img/canvas> rendering (QRMock + BarcodeMock components) + payload is on data-* attr. Spec asserts: bodyText.not.toMatch(/FK:A1B2C3D4/).

adversarial_findings.title: A2 screenshot detection mitigated by 5min QR rotation
adversarial_findings.evidence: useLoyaltyQR refreshes payload every 5 min. Screenshot taken at T0 expires at T+5min. SR live region announces 'Code QR expire dans 1 minute' (warn60) + 'Code QR expire dans 10 secondes' (warn10) — prevents user thinking it's static.

adversarial_findings.title: A3 localStorage tamper resistance (balance audit + history append-only)
adversarial_findings.evidence: Adversary edits localStorage.lecayenne.loyalty.balance to inflated value. App rehydrates on next read but balance reconstructed from history sum (audit pattern: sum(earn) - sum(redeem) + sum(refund_reversal)). Tamper detected if balance != reconstructed. Phase 6 will move authority to server-side; V0 client-side check is best-effort.

adversarial_findings.title: A4 double-tap apply-now → single redemption (inflight guard)
adversarial_findings.evidence: setInflight(true) before LC.dev.redeemReward. Button disabled aria-busy during inflight. Spec asserts: 2 rapid clicks → balance 347→247 (single -100) + history.filter(redeem).length === 1.

adversarial_findings.title: A5 browser back during wizard step 2 → no double-debit
adversarial_findings.evidence: Spec navigates: rewards→step1→step2→back→step1. Asserts: balance unchanged (347), history.filter(redeem).length === 0. WizardRedeem state machine: setStep(1) from step2 back btn does NOT call LC.dev.redeemReward.

adversarial_findings.title: Race condition (S09): parallel LC.dev.redeemReward → exactly 1 success
adversarial_findings.evidence: Two parallel Promise.allSettled redeems. V0 single-thread JS guarantees serialization. 1st reads balance=150, decrements to 50. 2nd reads 50 AFTER 1st resolved → fails INSUFFICIENT. Asserts: successes=1, failures=1, balance=50, history.filter(redeem).length === 1. Note: Phase 6 will need server Idempotency-Key + lockForUpdate to handle truly parallel HTTP calls — V0 single-thread does not guarantee this for distributed scenarios.

adversarial_findings.title: Idempotency key per WizardRedeem session (D-009 replay banner)
adversarial_findings.evidence: idempotencyKeyRef generated once at step1 mount via LC.loyaltyRewardState.redemptionIdempotencyKey(userId, reward_id). Key = `redeem-{user}-{reward}-{floor(now/10min)}`. Same key on back→retry within 10min window dedupes server-side. On replay: result.replayed=true → step3 renders 'Déjà échangée' + role='status' replay banner + no confetti + no toast about balance change. Boundary-crossing replay (>10min) documented as V0-only gap.

new_disputes.title: Cross-tab race (multi-tab redemption)
new_disputes.context: If user opens mobile/Le Cayenne - Prototype.html in 2 browser tabs simultaneously and clicks redeem in both, V0 single-thread argument breaks because each tab is its own JS context.
new_disputes.evidence: V0 spec S09 acknowledges this gap ('Phase 6 will test server-side Idempotency-Key + lockForUpdate'). loyalty.js doesn't use localStorage event listener for cross-tab sync. Realistically: prototype mobile is single-tab. Production native app = no cross-tab issue.
new_disputes.recommendation: Documented as V0 limitation. Production native iOS/Android app eliminates cross-tab vector. No heal required for prototype.

summary.verdict: GREEN — all 5 adversarial scenarios defended in current code; 2 V0-only gaps documented and acknowledged for Phase 6 server-side wireup
